text: Fewer sentence restarts than 93 in 100 speakers, against published speech research, not other Ethos users. An estimate for now.
A listener hears a sentence restart the way they hear an um, and it costs more.
A wrong word is no reason to restart the sentence. Finishing the weaker sentence beats abandoning it.
